个人环境设计 · personal-environment-design

中文指南

Design and configure a coherent environment for a person and model to work together. This Skill connects prompts, Skills, MCP, plugins, applications, automation, and local or cloud services with human-facing use. It considers capability, cognitive and interaction effort, resource use, reliability, and maintenance together.

Use and capabilities

Copy the complete directory into a Skill location supported by your agent host. There are no mandatory software dependencies or companion Skills. Investigation can begin with supplied descriptions; observing or changing a real environment requires the recipient's actual browser, desktop, application, or implementation tools and existing permissions. The Skill does not create those capabilities.

Use it when installing, connecting, configuring, replacing, or materially reorganizing the environment. Ordinary use of a configured tool does not require another design exercise, and a small fix stays within its affected dependencies. The method traces instruction or user action through discovery, connection, execution, and observable result. Relevant specialists keep their own methods and delivery responsibilities; companion Skills are used only where available.

For example, ask it to connect an MCP capability and assess whether a direct connection, shared local backend, or existing hosted service fits the actual client, state boundaries, and costs. Or ask it to inspect a launcher-to-project journey and implement a clearer way to resume work. The first needs representative client calls and evidence for claimed resource savings; the second needs readback of the affected journey and resulting effect. A saved configuration or attractive screen alone does not establish the intended improvement.

Package and adaptation

SKILL.md is the English model-facing entrypoint. Read resources for the affected part:

  • Human use retains the journey method: understanding, operation, coordination, and recovery across connected surfaces. It distinguishes model walkthroughs from measured human use.
  • MCP and services covers compatible transport, execution placement, safe sharing, measured costs, and successor verification.
  • Design basis explains the reusable distinctions and retained public design references, separating their support for usability from implementation-specific engineering evidence.

The aligned README editions explain adoption. This independent public adaptation generalizes local tool routing and configuration choices, replacing private originating quotations and conversation identifiers with standalone rationale. It includes no personal history, private sources, preconfigured services, or credentials.

This independent package uses the MIT License. Linked external references retain their own rights; their full texts are not bundled.
